fields.dataAffected: File CSV program loyalitas dengan sekitar 12.400 baris yang berisi nama, alamat email, nomor telepon, dan tanggal lahir anggota.
fields.whenAndHow: Bucket penyimpanan objek dapat diakses publik sejak perubahan konfigurasi pada 20 Februari 2026. Tim menerima pemberitahuan dari peneliti keamanan pada 3 Maret 2026 pukul 09.15 WIB.
fields.actionsTaken: Bucket diubah menjadi privat, log akses diperiksa, dan kunci akses penyimpanan dirotasi.

fields.dataAffected: Patient names, appointment dates, and treating doctors’ names in appointment confirmations stored in the shared front-desk mailbox. No medical records were stored in email.
fields.whenAndHow: On 11 April 2026 at 14:40 WIB, the identity provider raised an impossible-travel alert for a receptionist account. The receptionist had entered her password on a fake Microsoft 365 login page received by email that morning. The attacker accessed the shared front-desk mailbox for about 6 hours.
fields.actionsTaken: Reset the password, revoked all active sessions, removed an attacker-created forwarding rule, enforced multi-factor authentication for all staff, and scheduled phishing awareness training.

fields.dataAffected: Data 830 anggota, termasuk nama, NIK, dan sisa saldo pinjaman.
fields.whenAndHow: Pada 7 Mei 2026 pukul 16.05 WIB, seorang karyawan layanan pelanggan menyalin data anggota ke flashdisk USB pribadi. Hasil wawancara menunjukkan karyawan tersebut berniat menjual data kepada pihak penagih utang.
fields.actionsTaken: Akun karyawan dinonaktifkan, flashdisk diamankan, kasus dilaporkan ke polisi, dan hak akses seluruh staf layanan pelanggan ditinjau ulang.

fields.dataAffected: Shipping manifests for approximately 41,000 parcels, containing recipient names, delivery addresses, and phone numbers.
fields.whenAndHow: On Saturday, 6 June 2026, at 03:20 WIB, an on-call engineer confirmed that ransomware had encrypted the main file server after a monitoring alert. The attackers claimed they had exfiltrated the manifests; this has not yet been confirmed.
fields.actionsTaken: Isolated the affected network segment, restored the server from offline backups, engaged an external forensics firm to confirm what was copied, and decided not to pay the ransom.

fields.dataAffected: Nama, gaji bulanan, dan nomor rekening bank 54 karyawan.
fields.whenAndHow: Lampiran spreadsheet penggajian dikirim oleh staf HR ke alamat email eksternal yang salah karena fitur isi otomatis memilih kontak yang mirip. Waktu pertama kali kesalahan diketahui belum dapat dipastikan.
fields.actionsTaken: Staf mencoba menarik kembali email dan menghubungi penerima, yang mengonfirmasi secara tertulis bahwa email beserta lampirannya telah dihapus. Fitur isi otomatis untuk domain eksternal telah dimatikan.

fields.dataAffected: 2,150 policyholders’ names, policy numbers, and dates of birth.
fields.whenAndHow: On 19 July 2026, a regional sales manager reported that his work laptop had been left in a taxi earlier that evening. The laptop contained a local spreadsheet and was not protected by full-disk encryption.
fields.actionsTaken: A remote wipe command was issued, but the device has not come online. The manager’s passwords were changed, a police report was filed, and disk encryption is being enforced on every company laptop.

fields.dataAffected: Nama, nomor HP, dan alamat email pelanggan.
fields.whenAndHow: Kunci API produksi tidak sengaja di-commit ke repositori Git publik pada 31 Juli 2026. Pemindaian rahasia otomatis menemukan kunci tersebut pada 2 Agustus 2026 pukul 10.45 WIB. Log menunjukkan tiga alamat IP tak dikenal memanggil API sebanyak 1.900 kali.
fields.actionsTaken: Kunci dicabut dan diganti, riwayat repositori dibersihkan, alamat IP tersebut diblokir, dan pemeriksaan rahasia pre-commit diwajibkan.

fields.dataAffected: Subscriber email addresses, first names, and the product categories each subscriber follows. Passwords and payment data were not shared with the vendor.
fields.whenAndHow: On 25 August 2026, Pasar Sampel was informed by email that an attacker had accessed MailContoh’s platform and copied customer lists.
fields.actionsTaken: Suspended all data synchronisation to the vendor, requested its forensic report, started a review of the processing agreement, and will warn customers about possible phishing emails.

fields.dataAffected: Sekitar 3.700 baris data calon siswa, termasuk nama siswa, nama orang tua, alamat rumah, dan nomor telepon orang tua.
fields.whenAndHow: Pada 9 September 2026 pukul 01.12 sampai 01.40 WIB, serangan SQL injection melalui formulir pencarian portal pendaftaran memungkinkan penyerang mengunduh tabel calon siswa.
fields.actionsTaken: Portal dimatikan, query diganti menjadi parameterized query, kredensial database direset, dan uji penetrasi pihak ketiga dijadwalkan.

fields.dataAffected: User email addresses, bcrypt-hashed passwords, daily step counts, and body weight entries.
fields.whenAndHow: The incident was discovered during an internal audit on 30 September 2026 at 13:00 WIB. A database backup file was exposed on a staging web server with directory listing enabled. Server logs show it was downloaded twice by an external IP address during the previous two weeks.
fields.actionsTaken: Removed the file, disabled directory listing, forced a password reset for every user, and rebuilt the staging environment behind access controls.
